title: Use This Trick to Get GTA 6 Ultimate Edition on PS5 for Just $85 (Today Only)
summary: Today only, you can get a $100 PlayStation Store gift card for just $85 – and then use it to buy the Ultimate Edition of Grand Theft Auto 6 for PS5.

Home › GTA 6 Get GTA 6 Ultimate Edition on PS5 for Just $85 Using This Trick – Today Only Almost certainly the best deal you’ll find ahead of launch. By Chris Reed Updated : Oct 27, 2026 2:00pm UTC 9 comments Add IGN on Google Update Oct 27, 1pm ET: Unfortunately, this deal has sold out. I'll update this article if it comes back. As a commerce editor at IGN, I’ve been on the lookout for the best possible deal on Grand Theft Auto 6 — almost certainly the biggest game of the year. Since no retailer is offering a direct discount on GTA 6, the best way I’ve found to save money on it is to buy a PlayStation or Xbox gift card when it’s discounted at Newegg. Today only, Newegg has the best deal I’ve seen yet on a $100 PlayStation gift card . If you enter promo code GTWF2793 at checkout, you’ll save $15 — meaning you get $100 of PlayStation credit for $85 . That’s enough to buy you the Ultimate Edition of Grand Theft Auto 6, the edition most people are preordering . $100 PlayStation Store Digital Gift Card for $85 $100 PlayStation Store Digital Gift Card 9 $100.00 save 15% $85.00 at Newegg Use code ' GTWF2793 ' This is almost certainly the biggest discount we’ll see on gift cards ahead of GTA 6's November 19 launch, and thus the best deal available. In other words: if you want the Ultimate Edition of GTA 6 and you want the best deal possible, now is the time to buy. Once you buy the gift card (making double sure to use the promo code to get the deal), you should receive a code via email within an hour ( I just did it, and my code came six minutes after I placed the order ). You can redeem this code at the PlayStation Store for $100 in credit. To do so, just make sure you're signed in, and click your avatar in the upper right corner of the page. That will open a dropdown menu with the option "Redeem Code," where you can paste your code. Now that you have your funds, head to the Grand Theft Auto 6 page (your choice of standard edition or ultimate edition ) and preorder the game. Then you’re all set. Preorder Grand Theft Auto 6 - Ultimate Edition Out November 19 Grand Theft Auto 6 - Ultimate Edition (PS5) 0 $99.99 at PlayStation Store What do you get with the ultimate edition? To quote Rockstar, it includes “an exclusive collection of premium vehicles, weapons, apparel, and action threaded across all aspects of Jason and Lucia’s story.” Here's a full rundown. GTA 6 Ultimate Edition Includes: Exclusive Vehicles & Storage Vapid Dominator Buggy with access to the Paradise Garage, including a weapon locker and stash box. '95 Grotti Cheetah sports car with a retro-inspired design. Dinka Enduro motorcycle, Crest Kayak, and exclusive Vapid Ganado pickup truck upgrades at Jason's Safehouse. Shitzu Squalo speedboat equipped with a weapons crate. Extra Vehicle Content Access to two exclusive vehicle customization shops: Rideout Customs (Vice City) One-Eyed Willie's (Lake Leonida) Classic Car Collection side activity featuring restoration projects, including four Ultimate Edition-exclusive vehicles. Exclusive Weapons Hawk & Little Morgan Revolver with unique Vice City-themed designs for Jason and Lucia. Personalized versions of Jason's Girardi ES9 pistol and Lucia's Klose K17 pistol. Additional Missions & Activities PTT Youngin$ Compound content, including a special robbery opportunity and exclusive contraband rewards. Cosmetics & Character Customization Exclusive outfits, tattoos, and accessories for Jason and Lucia. Goodtime Gear clothing collection. Access to Stock 305, an exclusive streetwear store. Exclusive hairstyles, makeup, nails, and facial hair options from Sara's Unisex Salon. Over 50 exclusive tattoos from Electric Fang Tattoo. You can find more info in our GTA 6 preorder guide . While you can’t play the game until it comes out on November 19, you’ll be able to pre-load it onto your PS5 starting on November 12. That gives you a week to download it ahead of launch, so you don’t have to worry about slow network speeds once the game is available. Then, once November 19 rolls around, the game will unlock and you’ll be able to play the biggest game of the year. If you'd rather have a physical copy, that's cool – but I don't expect any deals or discounts to be available anywhere on physical copies. It's also worth noting that Grand Theft Auto 6 is only available in digital form. While Rockstar will sell you a “physical copy” ( see it at Amazon ), all you actually get is a game box with a download code in it. No discs for the game are being printed. So if you do want to save $15, this deal on PlayStation Store credit is the one to buy. Chris Reed Senior Commerce Editor X Chris Reed is a senior commerce editor and deals expert for IGN.
